messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated queueing and rising tail latency on runtime pool rdm-prod-us-east-2. Error spike 5xx from prefix cache miss. Auto-mitigation triggered: tenant-weight-adjust for tenant 'acme-io' applied.

sam: seeing 500s & 504s in the dashboard, latency p95 up to 2.4s in the last 5m. Is the auto action enough? @maria could you confirm customer impact?

maria: checking support logs now. acme-io reports slow responses and a few timed-out webhooks. They've got lots of small chat completions (~short sequences). Impact: degraded UX for some users, not a full outage.

raj: root cause looks like sudden spike of parallel short-chat requests causing KV cache churn + long scheduling queue. Inflight per-GPU hit the soft cap. We're seeing head-of-line delays.

kevin: recommendation: temporarily reduce max_inflight for tenant 'acme-io' from 80 -> 20 and enable quick-priority-demote on their traffic class. Also disable streaming for the tenant to reduce token-level pressure.

sam: sound plan. Can you run the commands? I'll coordinate comms and quota changes.

raj: running throttle now.

ops-bot: executed: set-tenant-param --tenant acme-io --max_inflight 20 --reason "live mitigation due to queueing spike" --by raj

maria: updated support ticket, flagged affected customers and set expectation: ~30% slower responses, retries may help. Notifying account team.

anya-support: pinged CSM, asked if we should enable fallback model (smaller) for critical routes. They said yes for webhook endpoints.

kevin: applied streaming disable for acme-io via traffic-policy toggle.

ops-bot: executed: traffic-toggle --tenant acme-io --feature streaming --state off --by kevin

raj: also tuning timeouts: reducing per-request decode timeout from 30s -> 10s for that tenant to free stuck inflight slots.

sam: note to oncall: this will make some long-running requests error faster, but reduces head-of-line blocking. We accept that tradeoff until load subsides. Updating incident status.

maria: customer contacted, CSM acknowledges. No billing impact planned. We'll keep them posted every 15m.

kevin: enabling temporary rate cap for non-critical endpoints: set-rate --tenant acme-io --route "/analytics" --rps 5

ops-bot: executed: set-rate --tenant acme-io --route "/analytics" --rps 5 --by kevin

raj: observing queues now: inflight dropped ~65% in 2m, p95 latency trending down. KV miss rate still elevated but improving.

sam: good. Prep handoff to night oncall at +2h. Actions for followup: 1) Keep max_inflight=20 until healthy for 10m, 2) Rollback streaming-disable after stable 15m, 3) Consider ephemeral model fallback if traffic resumes.

maria: assigning followups in ops-runbook: @night-oncall please validate customer webhook retries and check CPU/GPU utilization. I'll update the ticket thread with mitigations done.

kevin: leaving note: commands run, logs archived to s3://rdw-incidents/6777771234/, trace ids: [trace-7f9a, trace-7fb1].

sam: OK closing active mitigation phase. Will reopen if we see >10% error rate again. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Incident log updated: incident-6777771234 mitigation actions recorded. Handoff scheduled to night-oncall at ts 6777779321."
